subject.title: Feishu channel dispatch fails with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading run)'

question: Should this be investigated as a new shared dispatch regression now, or held for a supported-runtime full stack and package-identity capture first?
rationale: The user impact is credible, but the prior identical root cause is already guarded and the current evidence does not identify which `.run` receiver is undefined.

options.title: Require targeted diagnostics
options.body: Ask for a Node 24 reproduction, full stack trace, and loaded package paths before selecting or queueing a code fix.

options.title: Sponsor live reproduction
options.body: Have a Feishu-capable owner reproduce the v2026.7.1 configuration and capture the failing runtime object directly.

recommendation.title: Require targeted diagnostics
recommendation.body: Ask for a Node 24 reproduction, full stack trace, and loaded package paths before selecting or queueing a code fix.
